t3.observation: releaseEntry separately drains subscribers, closes scope and writes release records; tool items interrupted is not proof of external business outcome; source inspection only

scope: Current actual migrations, run registry prepare/cancel-before-fork and mail recovery with controlled dead owner; candidate summary/admission over synthetic rows. No SDK/native fork, SMTP, business writes, UI or product changes.
findings: Current data execution-context records CANCELED as cancelled even for write without a separate effect field; cancellation alone is insufficient evidence of no external effect.
Read-only semantics establish no-write-effect, not successful delivery.
Four business ledgers need independent source coverage; required-source failure cannot be an empty list.
Source content fingerprint recheck in immediate transaction detects tested precommit changes, but no proof of complete launch arbitration or postcommit business exclusion.
candidateLimits: Selected metadata only, no production event projection or native launch
No real mailbox, browser or plugin write
Unknown/nonempty module targets intentionally unverified; object-level scope not implemented
Terminal executed mail result decoder not integrated; such rows conservatively unverified
Reads all historical source rows in candidate; no performance or migration coverage proof
No proof that schema-empty database contains complete prior history
